system.description:
Artefact (crystal globes, one for each draconic lineage; made before the Never-ending War by fanatics now forgotten). A dragon of the orb's lineage within a mile knows where it is. Once per day, every dragon of that lineage within a mile makes a Will save (DC 22): on a failure it submits to the wielder for a day; on a success it flees.

Drawback: each use, make a Will save or the orb takes your mind for a day.

Destroyed: by the breath of an ancient dragon of its own lineage.

Monsters & Treasure, Artefacts. Its save DC is 20 unless the entry says otherwise.
